modules.module_title: Carry out pre-operation checks on Aerial Work Platform — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: inspect the tyre for damage and bulges
check the wheels for loose lug bolts, twisted rims and fractures
examine the equipment for cracks, misalignment, welds, excessive mast movement and broken locking pins
check the hydraulic system reservoir, engine crankcase, engine coolant, transmission, air filter and axles are filled to the required operating fluid levels
inspect for defects such as cracked welds, fuel leaks, hydraulic leaks, damaged control cables or wire harness
examine whether the work platform and extension slides are clean, dry and debris-free
check the carrying basket for any physical damages and all the fastenings and linkages for any damages
check to see that the lower operational controls of boom lift equipment effectively override the top controls
ensure that the emergency lowering features are operational
after the equipment has been inspected, fill out the details in the checklist report
report any defect or abnormality in the equipment to the person responsible for the maintenance of the equipment

modules.module_title: Carry out aerial work platform equipment operations — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: throughout the lift, inspect the ground for enough strength to sustain the weight of both the machine and the load/workmen
set outriggers on pads or on a level, solid surface of boom lift equipment
ensure that the road side gradient is not more than 15 degree to avoid boom lift toppling
lower the platform using controls to allow the workmen enter into the boom or scissor lift
extend the boom, lift slowly and move the boom lift or scissor lift to the work area
determine the operating range based on the load capacities for the equipment
use the capacity chart to determine safe boom extension range
place the booms and lift in stewed position, when finished with the machine
keep the transmission in neutral and wait for the engine to slow down to idle speed
park the machine on a level surface
to prevent unauthorised operation, verify that the engine is switched off and the key is removed
communicate problems accurately to others, such as maintenance personnel
concerns should be documented and communicated to relevant individuals, such as a supervisor or a mechanic

modules.module_title: Carry out maintenance and troubleshooting of the aerial work — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: determine the right service schedule by tracking machine operating hours
check if all the plates are attached to the vehicle
replenish lubricants and fluids as needed or as directed by the manufacturer
dispose of waste lubricating oils, anti freeze and hydraulic fluids in accordance with local rules, or transport them to a recycling facility
check battery levels and condition of the terminals and carry out minor adjustments if required
fill up the fuel tank to keep water from condensing in it
ensure that no engine repair is conducted while the engine is running or remains hot
ensure the main is turned off from panel completely before carrying out maintenance work on the equipment
ensure that appropriate tools are used while troubleshooting
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of the role
dispose waste as per the guidelines of the site / organization
adhere to the reporting procedures established by the employer
complete all documents in accordance with the required standards on time
identify the issues and relevant repair procedures

modules.module_title: Operate and maintain telehandler equipment — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: check seat belt for damage, replace belt if frayed or cut webbing, damaged buckles or loose mounting hardware
check the gauges, switches, joysticks, horns and controls for proper condition
check for frame level indicator and window glass for damages
check all the lighting systems for proper working condition
check the ground for adequate strength to support the weight of both the machine and the load throughout the lift
determine the operating range based on the load capacities for the equipment
ensure that the correct carriage and forks are being used before loading the material
adjust spacing of forks to engage the pallet or load at max width
position the telescopic handler to place or retrieve the load without moving or repositioning the machine
engage the load, rest it against the backrest and tilt it back slightly
drive the telescopic handler to the landing location
align forks of telescopic handler at the level at which the load is to be placed, then extend boom slowly until load is just above area where it is to be placed
until the load rests in position, lower the boom of the telescopic handler and the forks should be free to retract
bring the machine to the parking lot
allow the engine to idle speed and shift the transmission to neutral
park the machine on a level surface
make sure that the engine is off and remove the ignition key of the telescopic handler
by monitoring the machine working hours, plan the correct service schedule
check if all the plates are attached onto the vehicle
before doing maintenance work, main power should be switched off from the panel
top up lubricants and fluids as per schedule or running hours of the machine
follow reporting procedures as laid down by the employer
systematically complete the documentation in the approved standards
if beyond scope of role, report defects to the supervisor
as per the guidelines of the site / organisation, dispose the waste
